info.title: Enterprise Users API
info.description: API for managing Feedly Enterprise users and resources

get.description:
Retrieves a list of all users in the enterprise account with their activity metrics and profile information.

**Export Options:**
- Add `?format=csv` to the URL to export the user list as a CSV file instead of JSON

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format (omit for JSON, use 'csv' for CSV export)

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions to access enterprise user data

firstLogin.description: EPOCH timestamp in milliseconds of the user's first login

isAdmin.description: Whether the user has administrator privileges

joinDate.description: EPOCH timestamp in milliseconds when the user joined

lastActivity.description: EPOCH timestamp in milliseconds of the user's last activity

logins.description: Array of login identifiers associated with this user

numDaysActiveDesktopPastMonth.description: Number of days the user was active on desktop in the past month

numDaysActiveDesktopPastWeek.description: Number of days the user was active on desktop in the past week

numDaysActiveMobilePastMonth.description: Number of days the user was active on mobile in the past month

numDaysActiveMobilePastWeek.description: Number of days the user was active on mobile in the past week

numDaysActivePastMonth.description: Total number of days the user was active in the past month

numDaysActivePastWeek.description: Total number of days the user was active in the past week

numLongReadEntriesPastMonth.description: Number of long-read articles read in the past month

numLongReadEntriesPastWeek.description: Number of long-read articles read in the past week

numReadEntriesPastMonth.description: Total number of articles read in the past month

numReadEntriesPastWeek.description: Total number of articles read in the past week

numTaggedEntriesPastMonth.description: Number of articles tagged in the past month

numTaggedEntriesPastWeek.description: Number of articles tagged in the past week

totalReadingTimePastMonth.description: Total reading time in seconds for the past month

totalReadingTimePastWeek.description: Total reading time in seconds for the past week
